title: Lagged Procrustean Randomization Test for Multivariate Time Series
text: lagprotest extends Procrustean randomization test (PROTEST) ordered multivariate series. scans Procrustes concordance two configurations across candidate temporal lags, tests lag permutation, returns lag profile, lag maximal concordance (minimum m²), global p-value accounts scanning several lags selecting best one, per-observation Procrustes residuals. Three permutation schemes available: permutation = "phase" (default): phase-randomized surrogates Y, keep autocorrelation variable cross-correlations among . Recommended global p-value. permutation = "cyclic": cyclic shifts full series, optionally time reversal, applied lagging. Keeps temporal autocorrelation null, global p-value low power. permutation = "free": free permutation rows within overlapping window, vegan::protest(). Rows assumed exchangeable, autocorrelated series violate; Type error can severely inflated.
